# vaultwarden_organization_collections (Data Source)

Use this data source to list the collections of an organization. The provider user must be a confirmed owner or admin of the organization, or a manager with access to all collections, because collection names are encrypted with the organization key.

Requires `email` and `master_password` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vaultwarden_organization_collections" "example" {
  organization_id = "53878c48-51e9-416d-b31a-1b4209c93832"
}

# The names of all collections
output "collection_names" {
  value = data.vaultwarden_organization_collections.example.collections[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization

### Read-Only

- `collections` (Attributes List) The collections of the organization, sorted by name (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collections))

<a id="nestedatt--collections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collections`

Read-Only:

- `external_id` (String) The external ID of the collection, `null` when not set
- `id` (String) The ID of the collection
- `name` (String) The name of the collection
